description: Shows a short recap above the composer, so you can pick up a thread without rereading it. Close it with × once you have read it; it stays closed on every device until a newer recap replaces it. Recaps follow the language of your latest messages, or one language you set. Other layouts add a compact banner, an expanded banner and a larger card. Each recap is a normal request to the provider you choose and never enters the thread's context.
